episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Murder has come to Rome,Wisconsin! The small town of Rome, Wisconsin gets more excitement than it can handle when a famous rock band hits town just after the Tin Man is murdered during a production of "The Wizard of Oz."

episodes.title: The Green Bay Chopper
episodes.summary: Max's persistence at solving the case of a serial kidnapper leads to a dispute with the FBI.

episodes.title: Mr. Dreeb Comes to Town
episodes.summary: A circus midget wins sympathy with an animal-cruelty suit while a teacher with a brain tumor is forgotten.

episodes.title: The Autumn of Rome
episodes.summary: Brock takes a stand on ethics and the fate of Rome when the town's mayoral race opens up a Pandora's box of under-the-table dealings.

episodes.title: Frank the Potato Man
episodes.summary: Is Frank the potato man guilty of serial bathing? Rome struggles with misleading stereotypes and sexual harassment.

episodes.title: Remembering Rosemary
episodes.summary: Questions arise about a woman's death 10 years earlier, and Maxine investigates the possibility of murder instead of suicide.

episodes.title: The Contenders
episodes.summary: Kenny boxes with a former middleweight champ while Jill comes out fighting as a candidate for mayor.

episodes.title: Sacred Hearts
episodes.summary: Jill and Zack discover an elderly woman dead and the evidence points to a mercy killing. Did a nun do the deed?

episodes.title: Thanksgiving
episodes.summary: Jill's father brings along a much younger love interest on his Thanksgiving visit. Meanwhile, Wambaugh catches his wife cheating, and Kenny and Max share dinner.

episodes.title: The Snake Lady
episodes.summary: Brock and his team must read the fine print when a young wife's death could lead to a sizable insurance payoff for either her husband or her sister.

episodes.title: Pageantry
episodes.summary: Rome's Christmas pageant at a public school is ruled a violation of separation of church and state but another controversy unfolds with the arrest of a teacher.

episodes.title: High Tidings
episodes.summary: The Brock family returns from a Christmas Eve outing with plans to surprise Kimberly, but they're in for the real surprise.

episodes.title: Frog Man
episodes.summary: Unnerved when Kenny is shot during the investigation of a store break-in, Max botches the arrest of the prime suspect.

episodes.title: Bad Moons Rising
episodes.summary: When a woman is charged with killing the husband she is about to divorce, Wambaugh attempts to build a temporary insanity plea based on menopause.

episodes.title: Nuclear Meltdowns
episodes.summary: When a school friend gets pregnant, Kimberly tells her parents she thinks it resulted from incest.

episodes.title: The Body Politic
episodes.summary: A dentist who hasn't disclosed his HIV infection has the town up in arms; Kenny takes flak for dating twins.

episodes.title: Be My Valentine
episodes.summary: Maxine recognizes the MO of a serial killer when she gets an odd response to a personal ad.

episodes.title: Fetal Attraction
episodes.summary: Jill calls on her ex-fiancé, a leading neurosurgeon, to perform a fetal-tissue transplant that could cure a patient's Parkinson's disease.

episodes.title: Sightings
episodes.summary: Carter's autopsy of a body reveals radiation scars (and cancer), leading him to believe that the man had witnessed a spaceship crash.

episodes.title: Rights of Passage
episodes.summary: Native Americans protesting a golf-course development on a burial ground take over the courthouse.

episodes.title: Sugar and Spice
episodes.summary: Matthew discovers that Kimberly has kissed a girl; Maxine and Kenny compete for the post of undersheriff.

episodes.title: The Lullaby League
episodes.summary: Jill is frustrated when a blues vocalist takes ill and fails to appreciate medicine's ability to keep her alive.

episodes.title: Turpitude
episodes.summary: Mayor Pugen is caught between a Brock and a hard place when the Sheriff arrests him for murdering a disarmed carjacker, leaving him to rely on Wambaugh for his defense.

episodes.title: Duty Free Rome
episodes.summary: Wambaugh appeals Mayor Pugen's conviction and uncovers a technicality that could secure a new trial.

episodes.title: Unlawful Entries
episodes.summary: Things don't add up when a math teacher says he was a date-rape victim; Brock locks horns with a new mayor.

episodes.title: Under the Influence
episodes.summary: Still reeling from her relationship with Dr. Shreve, Max allows a drunken driver to continue on home.

episodes.title: The Dancing Bandit
episodes.summary: A modern Robin Hood and her team prance into Rome to rob from the rich and give to the needy: local flood victims.

episodes.title: Dairy Queen
episodes.summary: Brock investigates the possibility that a model is the victim of spouse abuse. Meanwhile, some members of the community are having a cow over a local dairy's ad campaign featuring the model in racy shots.

episodes.title: Cross Examination
episodes.summary: Some members of the community don't know what to believe when a woman pulled from a submerged vehicle is discovered to be pregnant---even though she is technically a virgin.

episodes.title: Strangers
episodes.summary: A jury must decide if it's murder or a mistake after a man shoots and kills his own brother when the sibling enters his home in the middle of the night.

episodes.title: Blue Christmas
episodes.summary: The drug war comes to Rome in place of Santa: controlled substances are found on the high school campus and a federal witness turns up in town.

episodes.title: Paging Doctor God
episodes.summary: Jill does her best to uphold the Hippocratic oath when she treats a Christian Scientist who has refused care and whose husband takes the fight to court.

episodes.title: Guns 'R' Us
episodes.summary: Embarrassed by a prank, Matthew tries to get even with some boys. Meanwhile, budget cuts hit the sheriff's department.

episodes.title: Remote Control
episodes.summary: The debate over crime reaches a fever pitch when the mayor moves forward with new legislation to curb violence.

episodes.title: Abominable Snowman
episodes.summary: With his mind failing due to Alzheimer's, Howard Buss proposes that doctors harvest his heart for the transplant his son needs.

episodes.title: Supreme Courting
episodes.summary: Valentine's Day brings love and controversy to assorted age groups: Carter is smitten with a widow, Zack finds his first love, and Kimberly's boyfriend is too prudent.

episodes.title: Divine Recall
episodes.summary: The mayor scolds a priest for giving a pep talk colored with religious ideals to a public school's hockey team.

episodes.title: Terms of Estrangement
episodes.summary: Sheriff Brock tries to remain professional when Kimberly is kidnapped---and his onetime partner is the prime suspect.

episodes.title: Squatter's Rights
episodes.summary: When an obese woman confesses to murdering her husband, Max has some doubts about the motive.

episodes.title: System Down
episodes.summary: Sheriff Brock becomes the unlikely foreman of a jury deciding the case of an accused cop killer.

episodes.title: Buried Alive
episodes.summary: A visit by Jill's father leads to a lively evening of therapy in the Brock household.

episodes.title: My Left Shoe
episodes.summary: Mayor Buss criticizes Father Barrett on public-access cable, prompting a lawsuit.

episodes.title: Frosted Flakes
episodes.summary: The parents of a dying boy try to get the court's permission to use an unorthodox procedure to save the child's life.

episodes.title: Howard's End
episodes.summary: Howard Buss's Alzheimer's worsens, pushing his family to the breaking point.

episodes.title: Survival of the Fittest
episodes.summary: Sheriff Brock fears the worst when a teenager disappears. Meanwhile a teacher may be advocating creationism in a public school.

episodes.title: Systematic Abuse
episodes.summary: DA Littleton prepares for a showdown with Wambaugh as the case against Brian Latham goes to trial.

episodes.title: The Bus Stops Here (1)
episodes.summary: A Federal judge orders that 400 black students be bused to Rome's schools from Green Bay.

episodes.title: Enemy Lines (2)
episodes.summary: Jill and Judge Nance reveal their personal frustrations in heated meetings.

episodes.title: Cold Spell
episodes.summary: A social worker takes a girl from her mother, who practices witchcraft; Max and Kenny go to Ginny's to discuss the occult.

episodes.title: Elective Conduct
episodes.summary: A school report by Zachary hurts Jill's mayoral campaign just before the election.

episodes.title: Rebels with Causes
episodes.summary: An ailing Wambaugh travels to Chicago for specialized treatment; an announcement by Kenny and Kimberly angers Brock.

episodes.title: May It Please the Court
episodes.summary: Wambaugh and Littleton present their arguments concerning the Latham case to the Supreme Court.

episodes.title: For Whom the Wind Blows
episodes.summary: Sentencing nears for Brian Latham, the drifter convicted of murder; Brock questions his own resolve as sheriff.

episodes.title: Away in the Manger
episodes.summary: Brock and his deputies search a dairy farm where Carter suspects genetic experiments are taking place.

episodes.title: Freezer Burn
episodes.summary: Sheriff Brock and his deputies investigate the death of a male massage therapist.

episodes.title: Frogman Returns
episodes.summary: The Frogman is at the center of controversy once again when his son tires of his antics and goes to court for emancipation.

episodes.title: Mr. Seed Goes to Town
episodes.summary: A surprise visit by Jimmy's ex-wife rocks the Brock household when the woman announces her plan to have another child.

episodes.title: Close Encounters
episodes.summary: Max has a proposition for Kenny; Carter has a close encounter with a special woman.

episodes.title: When in Rome
episodes.summary: Jill and Jimmy must reconcile parental concerns with their professional duties when a convicted child molester chooses to live in Rome.

episodes.title: Heroes and Villains
episodes.summary: Zack questions authority---including Brock's---when the "Dancing Bandit" is arrested upon returning to Rome to wish the boy a happy birthday.

episodes.title: Changing of the Guard
episodes.summary: Brock looks outside his department for help in finding missing mayor Ed Lawson. Meanwhile, the town launches a search for a new mayor.

episodes.title: Without Mercy
episodes.summary: Brock's renewed commitment to thorough police work leads to the discovery of a mercy killing.

episodes.title: Final Judgement
episodes.summary: After Jill's criminal trial, Judge Bone is asked to rule on the validity of a law prohibiting physician-assisted suicide.

episodes.title: Saint Zach
episodes.summary: A remorseful Zack has a religious experience that creates quite a stir in the town.

episodes.title: Upbringings
episodes.summary: A visit by Jimmy's attorney father creates tension in the Brock household.

episodes.title: The Song of Rome
episodes.summary: After a youth shoots Father Barrett during an attempted robbery, the mayor's decision to continue with a spring pageant draws fire from somber townsfolk.

episodes.title: A Change of Season
episodes.summary: Kimberly changes her college plans; a fire imperils Carter; and Mayor Bey proposes changes to the sheriff's uniforms.

episodes.title: Reap the Whirlwind
episodes.summary: As a tornado threat looms over Rome, Wambaugh blows it while toasting his wife at his anniversary party; and Kenny's life nearly spins out of control.

episodes.title: Pal Joey
episodes.summary: A doctor---who's also a TV personality---sets her sights on Jill's practice; cultural differences figure in the arrest of an immigrant.

episodes.title: Bloodbrothers
episodes.summary: DA Littleton faces a figure from his past when two prison escapees make their way to Rome.

episodes.title: Dog Eat Dog
episodes.summary: Max is grilled in court after a tussle with a man dressed in a bratwurst costume. Meanwhile, Jill is suspicious when Kimberly visits Dr. Joey.

episodes.title: Heart of Saturday Night
episodes.summary: Saturday night in Rome: Jill and Brock have the house to themselves when Matthew heads out to party with friends.

episodes.title: Down the Tubes
episodes.summary: Cryptic dreams after his brother's death lead Littleton to an epiphany. Meanwhile, Brock polkas with Mayor Bey; and Jill struggles to stay a step ahead at work amid personal turmoil.

episodes.title: This Little Piggy
episodes.summary: An animal-rights group that counts Kimberly as a member protests a pig-wrestling event at the town fair; and Dr. Joey becomes emotionally attached to a cancer patient.

episodes.title: Witness for the Prosecution
episodes.summary: The death of a gay man during a papal parade in Rome, Wis., is thought to be a suicide---until an unlikely witness speaks out.

episodes.title: Dem Bones
episodes.summary: Wambaugh and his son are on opposite sides of a murder trial involving a Jew accused of murdering a Nazi in 1943.

episodes.title: Bloodlines
episodes.summary: Matthew is traumatized by a classmate's suicide, causing Jimmy to pay him extra attention. Meanwhile, difficulties in dissection class make Kimberly doubt her calling to study medicine.

episodes.title: Snow Exit
episodes.summary: A blizzard hits Rome, stranding together the feuding Bone and Wambaugh, and forcing Jill to deal with Jimmy's ex-wife.

episodes.title: My Romance
episodes.summary: Judge Bone is reunited with an old friend; Carter is shocked by a live wire; and Zack's heartstrings go zing over a young cellist.

episodes.title: The Z Files
episodes.summary: Misadventures in cyberspace: Zack creates a porno picture of his teacher that ends up on the World Wide Web, while Max finally meets the man she's been "chatting" with.

episodes.title: Bottled
episodes.summary: Feelings long bottled up surface at Zack's party, which finds Jill enduring a mid-life crisis, and Wambaugh bristling over Bone's lack of respect.

episodes.title: Dante's Inferno
episodes.summary: When Maxine's appointed interim mayor, her power goes to her head---and makes her the target of a misogynistic deejay, who's putting ugly thoughts into his listeners' minds.

episodes.title: Bye-Bye, Bey-Bey
episodes.summary: Laurie reveals that she bore her son for her gay brother and his lover, an announcement that brings their mother back into their lives.

episodes.title: Three Weddings and a Meltdown
episodes.summary: Sue and Carter, then Maxine and Kenny, announce their engagements; Myriam convinces Wambaugh to represent a widow charged with killing three of her husbands; Jill walks out on Jimmy.

episodes.title: Winner Takes All
episodes.summary: Jill's shot at coaching Zack's basketball team turns into an obsession---until Zack and his teammates take their parents to court to keep the adults from interfering.

episodes.title: Forget Selma
episodes.summary: Myriam's relationship with a stockbroker devastates Wambaugh, who comes to suspect her new love is up to no good.

episodes.title: To Forgive is Divine
episodes.summary: An Amish woman raped by a Rome resident refuses to testify on religious grounds. When the alleged rapist strikes again, the second victim's parents sue the Amish community.

episodes.title: Liver Let Die
episodes.summary: Jimmy suspects the murder of a transient is linked to a teenager and his mentally handicapped brother.
